requirements.title: Fundamental Technical Limitations
requirements.requirement: Fundamental Technical Limitations: all mapped child obligations below

requirements.title: DNS Is Not a VPN
requirements.requirement: Ordinary DNS does not route traffic; rewritten address needs authorized original-destination context

requirements.title: SNI and Encrypted Client Hello Limitations
requirements.requirement: ECH hidden inner SNI prevents reliable SNI-only dispatch; fail closed or use explicitly supported alternative

requirements.title: HTTP/3 and QUIC
requirements.requirement: QUIC/HTTP3 is UDP; TCP-only DNS gateway cannot promise interception or client QUIC disablement

requirements.title: HTTPS/SVCB DNS Records
requirements.requirement: Handle HTTPS/SVCB ALPN/IP hints/ECH/alternative endpoints; no blanket record removal as universal fix

requirements.title: DNSSEC
requirements.requirement: Separate normal verifiable DNSSEC answers from local overrides; rewritten response cannot claim authentic signature

requirements.title: Applications Can Bypass DNS
requirements.requirement: Own DoH/DoT/hardcoded IP/cache bypass DNS; full endpoint control requires client/router cooperation

requirements.title: Identification Behind NAT
requirements.requirement: Shared public NAT IP cannot identify individual device or link DNS to later TCP authorization

requirements.title: Other Limitations
requirements.requirement: CDN/shared IP, pinning, geo service checks, TTL/session lag and IPv6 policy limit route guarantees
